geometry_edits: Rebuilt the structural shell from the named 10-point OSM outline in project campus coordinates.
Replaced the 16 m fallback extrusion with a one-story stone cottage; wall top 3.35 m, eaves about 3.48 m and ridge about 5.55 m, all estimated from qualitative imagery.
Added a terracotta roof-envelope infill from the 2018 Indiana LiDAR outline and three stepped hipped roof volumes aligned to an estimated 40 degree NE-SW axis, with a procedural brick tile pattern.
Added stone trim, photo-guided window and door approximations, and a broad veranda with enlarged limestone piers and low stone parapet sections.
Removed the unsupported separate porch canopy and access ramp/rails; roof texture is procedural and has no external image dependencies.

validation.method: Asset rebuilt and reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS using audit/massing_the_caretaker_s_cottage_6b24af9/reopen_validate.py.

uncertainties: No measured elevation, architectural plan, or verified building height was found; wall, eave and ridge heights are estimates.
OSM way 953041335 is a community-mapped wall/base outline, not a cadastral or architectural survey.

Indiana LiDAR footprint objectid 433415 is a larger roof-envelope candidate (209.76 m2 versus 159.48 m2 for OSM), with 0.86 m centroid separation and 0.722 IoU; it is not treated as a surveyed foundation.
Orthophoto service coverage is 2022-2025 but the exact local capture date is unavailable.
Roof intersections and tile scale, story-height, openings, entrance and porch dimensions are qualitative interpretations.
